# File `pre-commit`

Reject commits whose signing or author policy is not ready.

A pre-commit hook runs before Git creates the commit object, so no signature exists yet. It checks that repository signing is enabled and validates the exact identity Git plans to record. The pre-push signature check remains the backstop that inspects the completed object.
